caption: The drawing features a piece of furniture represented in two views: a front elevation on the left and a side elevation on the right. The front elevation shows a cabinet with a prominent cornice at the top, beneath which there are several small compartments arranged in three rows, each compartment fitted with a keyhole. At the center of the upper section is a larger rectangular compartment with a lock, flanked by symmetrically arranged smaller drawers and compartments. Beneath this section, there is a horizontal space divided by a fold-down panel that serves as a writing surface as seen in the side elevation. Below this fold-down panel, there are two large drawers, each with a centrally located keyhole and two circular handles. The cabinet stands on four short, round, and stepped feet. The side elevation to the right illustrates the depth of the piece, the overhang of the cornice, the thickness of the cabinet, and the extended position of the fold-down writing surface, which is supported by a metal rod or hinge. The drawing is monochromatic, rendered in thin, precise black lines on a beige, slightly aged background.
title: Desk
